scope: Standard native parameter, atom identity, snapshot, independent constraint inventory and unsupported virtual-site validation; not physical parameter accuracy or app readiness.
new_guards: Full-system unvalidated additional potential-energy forces reject even when physical bonds match
Constraints match independently declared pairs and lengths; missing inventory means no constraints
Boundary terms and constraints remain explicitly unvalidated in site scope
Virtual sites within validated scope reject until geometry is independently supported; outside partial-scope virtual sites remain explicitly unvalidated context
independent_review: Reproduced a full-system false-pass by adding an undeclared massless TwoParticleAverageSite to a parameter-matched specimen; validator and finite Context both accepted before this guard. Three new regression cases cover full, included partial and excluded partial scope.
